description: Woodland High School, part of the Woodland Joint Unified School District, serves students in Woodland, California, offering comprehensive academic programs, career technical education, athletics, and arts. It aims to prepare students as positive, productive, and professional citizens, with a focus on academic success and community engagement.

name: UC Davis School of Law
description: A law school located on the University of California, Davis campus.
_description: UC Davis School of Law, also known as King Hall, provides legal education through J.D. and LL.M. degrees, serving prospective and current students, and graduates. It offers various areas of study, centers, clinics, and experiential learning opportunities, contributing to the legal profession in the Greater Sacramento region and beyond.

name: Cottonwood Post-Acute Rehabilitation
description: Cottonwood Healthcare Center provides skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and memory care services in Woodland, CA, serving individuals recovering from medical events or procedures. They offer personalized care plans and operate a state-of-the-art therapy gym.

name: Woodland Public Works
description: Woodland Public Works maintains and expands the City of Woodland's transportation and utilities infrastructure, serving over 61,000 residents in the Greater Sacramento region of California. Key activities include fleet maintenance for over 700 city vehicles, managing electrical, signs, and streets, and providing water, sewer, and storm services.

name: Golden Brands
description: A company involved in the production or distribution of various branded products.

name: Raley's Production Bakery
description: The central bakery facility for Raley's, producing baked goods for their stores.

name: Tony's Fine Foods
description: Tony's Fine Foods, established in 1934, is a premier wholesale distributor and importer of gourmet and specialty food products, including deli, bakery, and perishable items. Headquartered in West Sacramento, CA, it serves restaurants, hotels, retailers, and grocery chains across California and the western United States, operating with over 10,000 employees.

name: UNFI Fresh
description: UNFI is a wholesale food distributor offering over 250,000 natural, organic, and conventional SKUs, including fresh produce, meat, and dairy. They serve 30,000 customer locations across North America, providing distribution and professional services to retailers and suppliers.

name: Syngenta Seeds
description: Syngenta Seeds is a global leader in agricultural technology, researching, developing, and producing high-quality seeds for corn, soybeans, vegetables, and flowers. They serve farmers and growers worldwide, offering innovative solutions to enhance crop yield and quality, with a significant R&D presence in California.

name: Student Health & Counseling Services
description: Student Health & Counseling Services (SHCS) at UC Davis provides comprehensive wellness, illness, and injury care, along with various counseling services, to all registered students. Key activities include primary care, specialty services, mental health support, health promotion, and pharmacy services, operating from the Student Health & Wellness Center and North Hall.

name: Comfort Keepers
description: Comfort Keepers of Sacramento Metro provides non-medical in-home senior care, serving families across Sacramento, Placer, and El Dorado Counties since 2002. They offer personalized care plans including companion care, personal care, respite care, 24-hour care, and specialized Alzheimer's & dementia care, focusing on elevating the human spirit through Interactive Caregiving™.

name: Woodland Nursing & Rehabilitation
description: A facility providing skilled nursing care and rehabilitation services.

name: Sutter Davis Hospital
description: Sutter Davis Hospital is a 57-licensed bed, nonprofit acute care hospital in Davis, California, serving Yolo County and the Greater Sacramento region. It delivers high-quality emergency, surgical, and maternity care, alongside medical-surgical and intensive care, focusing on advanced medicine and compassionate community service.

name: Courtyard Healthcare Center
description: A healthcare facility offering medical and rehabilitative services.

name: University Retirement Community
description: A community offering retirement living options and services.

name: McKesson Corporation
description: McKesson Corporation is a diversified healthcare services leader distributing pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America. They offer solutions for pharmacies, oncology and multispecialty care, biopharma capabilities, and prescription benefits, aiming to advance health outcomes for patients and providers.

name: Promega Corporation
description: Promega Corporation is a global leader providing over 4,000 innovative solutions and technical support to the life sciences industry. They develop and manufacture reagents, kits, and instruments for genomics, protein, cellular analysis, drug discovery, and human identification, serving academic, government, and pharmaceutical scientists worldwide.

name: Davis Police Department
description: The Davis Police Department, a department of the City of Davis, provides public safety and law enforcement services to the residents of Davis, California. Its key activities include crime prevention and maintaining order within the community.

name: Yolo County District Attorney
description: The Yolo County District Attorney's Office prosecutes criminal violations, advocates for victims, and promotes public safety across Yolo County, California. With approximately 120 employees, it handles around 10,000 criminal cases annually, focusing on areas like fraud, consumer protection, and high-tech crimes.

name: Hoblit Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram
description: Hoblit Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram is a fourth-generation, family-owned dealership in Woodland, CA, serving the Greater Sacramento region since 1949. It sells new and used Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram vehicles, offers commercial sales, and provides vehicle service and parts to individuals and businesses.

name: Davis Ace Hardware
description: Davis Ace Hardware is a locally owned retail store in Davis, CA, offering a wide range of home improvement, garden, and pet supplies, including lumber, paint, and tools. It serves diverse customers with products and services like key cutting and workshops across its main location and a satellite store.

name: Davis Food Co-Op
description: The Davis Food Co-op is a community-owned grocery store established in 1972, serving over 8,000 households in Davis, California. It provides fresh, local produce and groceries, fostering community through shared values and local partnerships.

name: Mariani Nut Company
description: Mariani Nut Company is a family-owned business that cultivates, processes, and sells natural and organic almonds, walnuts, and pecans. Based in Winters, CA, they serve consumers and growers, emphasizing sustainable practices like solar power and efficient irrigation.

name: Buckhorn Steakhouse
description: Buckhorn Steakhouse operates a restaurant in Winters, CA, specializing in high-quality, 42-day aged Prime Certified Angus Beef® sirloin, hand-cut and broiled for discerning customers. They also offer private events and catering services.

name: Recology Yuba-Sutter
description: Recology Yuba-Sutter provides recycling, composting, and landfill collection services for businesses and residents in the Yuba-Sutter region. They offer specialty services, manage household hazardous waste, and operate transfer stations and a landfill, contributing to a sustainable, circular economy.

name: Lindhurst High School
description: Lindhurst High School, part of the Marysville Joint Unified School District, guides and prepares students for success, serving the Olivehurst, CA community. The school provides academic programs, athletic opportunities, and student support services, including counseling and assistance with transcripts and diplomas.

name: Lone Tree School
description: Lone Tree School is an elementary school within the Wheatland School District, dedicated to providing high-quality education in a supportive environment. It serves students by fostering academic excellence, personal growth, and strong character through various programs, including a preschool program and after-school activities.

name: Marysville Joint Unified School District
description: The school district responsible for public education in the Marysville area.

name: Yuba County Public Works
description: Yuba County Public Works manages and maintains essential public infrastructure for the Yuba County community. Key activities include roadwork, capital improvements, bridge maintenance, drainage construction, and water resource management, encompassing planning, permitting, and construction projects across the county.

name: Adventist Health and Rideout
description: Adventist Health and Rideout is a not-for-profit, faith-based acute care hospital and healthcare system serving California's Yuba-Sutter region. It offers comprehensive services including emergency, surgical, cardiac, cancer, and maternity care, supported by over 2,100 employees and 300 physicians. The organization focuses on delivering personalized, whole-person care.

name: Marysville Care & Rehabilitation Center
description: A facility offering skilled nursing care and rehabilitation services in Marysville.

name: Bishop's Pumpkin Farm
description: Bishop's Pumpkin Farm, established in 1973, is a family-owned farm in Wheatland, California, offering fall-themed entertainment and farm-fresh food. It features a U-Pick pumpkin field, corn maze, petting zoo, train rides, and a bakery, serving families and schools in the Greater Sacramento region.
